The driver's own functions are the orion_x_* exports, a bump allocator, the panic handler and an eh-personality stub. Compiler: MSVC build (i686-pc-windows-msvc) with rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13), LLVM 23.1.1, the stable toolchain of the windows-2022 runner image. Measured x86: 573 kept + 130 glue + 973 excluded = 1676.
